protocol.selection: earliest accepted peak to peak; ideal 10 cycles; real 3 cycles
protocol.absoluteIdeal: small amplitude 0.2 kPa; 10 numerical cycles with parabolic sub-sample peak timing; no sensor quantization
protocol.suitableMetric: mean of each operation over 30 seeds; no runs removed
protocol.duration: last absolute physical pressure deviation >=0.5 kPa; baseline operation over 30..80 mm
